prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Define Your Pet's Desktop Personality", "Choose how active, playful, or quiet your companion will be on your desktop.", "Select Behavior Trait"]
1: ["Signing in anchors your companion data to this account so your custom pet is never lost or reset.", "Account Data Safeguard Active"]
2: ["Master Your Companion Controls", "Learn the essential shortcuts to summon, dock, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Desktop Shortcuts Quick Guide"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Rendering Engine", "We are verifying screen overlay permissions and graphic rendering settings for seamless desktop display.", "Desktop Overlay Status Check"]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Instant Preset Companion vs Custom Pet Creation"]
5: ["For best results, use bright lighting, clear focus, and a direct front-facing view of your pet.", "Photo Clarity Inspection Enabled"]
6: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Your pet is ready on your desktop! Sign in now to enable multi-device sync and cloud backup."]
7: ["Customize companion sounds and desktop notification alerts here.", "Desktop Sound Effects"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your pet a name and select its official adoption date to claim your unique companion badge.", "Official Pet Adoption Seal"]
9: ["If your pet doesn't appear on screen shortly, click here for quick multi-monitor overlay settings.", "Troubleshoot Desktop View"]
